title_cn: 美国针对伊朗实施新制裁和“经济愤怒”
summary: The US has promised a new round of economic sanctions in order to bring Iran back to the negotiating table after months of war. But the Islamic republic has faced many waves of sanctions for decades and it's unclear what effect a new period of "economic fury" will have, as Bloomberg's Tyler Kendall reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Farage’s Win Over Binface Is One Election He Wants to Forget
title_cn: 法拉奇战胜宾法斯是他想忘记的一场选举
summary: An election that pitted Nigel Farage against a man dressed as a bin, and turned the English resort town of Clacton into a seaside media circus, ended on Friday morning with a fizzle rather than a bang as the victorious Reform UK leader ducked out of public appearances.

title: Indonesia’s Prabowo to Widen Corruption Fight, Narrow Deficit
title_cn: 印度尼西亚总理普拉博沃将扩大反腐败斗争，缩小赤字
summary: Indonesia’s President Prabowo Subianto said he plans to narrow the budget deficit and root out corruption while still pursuing projects to support the most vulnerable citizens, doubling down on his paternalistic style of leadership and vision for the country of nearly 300 million people.
